pages.text: $(bold)Mechanical Prosthetics$(0) — a second path that complements organic organs: $(4)zero rejection$(0) and an $(4)integration$(0) value that only ever rises.$(br2)Implanted into its body slot via the "$(l:akaishi:surgery)Surgery Chamber$(/l)", it $(4)generates no rejection$(0), ignores adaptation, and never triggers enemy pairs or breakthrough. The trade-off: right after implanting only $(4)20%$(0) takes effect, and you must grow integration from 0 to 100 over time.$(br2)Nine finished pieces cover the nine slots: eye / heart / lung / viscera / kidney / left arm / right arm / left leg / right leg.

pages.title: One line, three machines
pages.text: $(li)1. $(l:akaishi:life_machines)Template Factory$(/l): universal shaping template + 1 life solid + both energies → 1 $(4)part template$(0) (choose the organ and part type in the GUI; DNA stays blank)$(li)2. Processing Factory: part template + matching material (core 3 / module 2 / shell 4 / cooling 2) + 1 life solid + both energies → $(4)processed part$(0); material tier sets part weight$(li)3. Assembly Station: one $(4)core / module / shell / cooling$(0) of the same organ + both energies → a $(4)finished prosthetic$(0)$(br2)The weights of all four parts together decide the finished stats.

pages.title: Integration and stats
pages.text: $(bold)Integration$(0) (0-100, $(4)never drops$(0)):$(li)Grows a tiny amount per tick; only whole points count; a $(4)mechanical heart$(0) multiplies growth by 1.5, without one it is 0.5$(li)Same-source (all four parts share the same non-empty DNA) adds another ×1.3$(li)Effective ratio = 20% + integration × 80% / 100$(br2)$(bold)Five stats$(0): overall multiplier / health / attack / attack speed / move speed, applied to the player as "weight × integration discount × config multiplier".$(br2)$(bold)Synergies$(0) (auto bonuses when all four parts qualify): Balanced, Extreme, Iron Wall, Wind, Same Source — see the item tooltip.$(br2)Hover a slot in the "$(l:akaishi:life_body)Body Scanner$(/l)" to read the current integration.
Read first: how to make organic organs (Organ Anatomy) and perform surgery (Surgery Chamber); prosthetics run on the Life Machines line, and integration is monitored in Body & Decay.
